ai_summary: Apollo Micro Systems Limited (AMS) has been strategically empanelled by the Indian Air Force as a Prime Development Agency for the Indigenous Precision Range Extension Kit (IPREK) program, marking its entry into India's high-value, import-dependent precision guided munition segment and creating a significant multi-year revenue opportunity. While this positions AMS as a key player in indigenizing critical defence technology, revenue generation is explicitly contingent upon the issuance of formal Project Sanction Orders and subsequent commercial procurement contracts, as the empanelment itself is not a firm order.
